anti_patterns: No Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings
No generic bolding, use font-black or font-light for contrast

rules: Never use pure black #000000 or pure grey #808080. Always tint greys.
Background must be deep obsidian, not flat.
Hover state color must be lighter hue of active state color.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in headers or overlays.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (Technical look). Container uses border-collapse style layout. Items have subtle borders on right and bottom.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers and floating video controls. bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-2xl and 1px delicate inner stroke border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Rely on 1px solid strokes (border-white/5) or 2px Inner Glow for tactical minimalism.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to eliminate digital flatness.

components.cards: Flat background (bg-zinc-900), 1px subtle border (border-zinc-800), rounded-md. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and border color brightens (border-zinc-600).
components.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle rounded-md. Primary buttons use bright accent (bg-[#00E5FF] text-black hover:bg-[#33EAFF]). Secondary buttons are outline with glass hover.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults customized to have bg-zinc-900, border-zinc-800, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00E5FF]/50.
components.video_player: Custom container with heavy glassmorphism controls overlay. Timeline should reflect the primary accent color.
components.navigation: Sticky left sidebar or top nav. MUST have solid or heavy glass background.
components.tabs: Shadcn tabs, override h-9 to h-auto. Active state should have a bottom border of #00E5FF.
components.toast: Use sonner for notifications. Dark mode styled.
components.dropdowns: Shadcn dropdown-menu, bg-zinc-900, solid background. NEVER transparent.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Tailwind Scale: p-4, p-6, p-8. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and data. Optical alignment over geometrical.

rules: Transition specifically: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. NO transition-all.
Entrance animations staggered for lists (e.g. deliverables list).
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.

images.description: Black and gray video camera setup in a dark studio.

media.icons: Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for high-end look).

3d_libraries.recommendation: None needed for core SaaS functionality, but consider Framer Motion for smooth tab/deliverable transitions.
3d_libraries.notes: Keep it 2D and highly readable due to heavy data (bookings, subscriptions, revisions).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, Manrope.
Implement Shadcn UI heavily but heavily customize the borders and backgrounds to match the Midnight Studio dark theme.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Ensure the timeline/review thread section looks distinct from standard chat boxes—make it feel like a video review tool.
Use pill-shaped or sharp button styles. No intermediate rounded corners for primary actions.
Apply data-testid to every clickable element (buttons, links, inputs, dropdown items).
Do NOT use text-align: center on the main app container.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
